nodes.procedure: Electrodes with different Ni/Fe ratios were prepared by simply tuning the molar ratio of the Ni precursor over the Fe one... nodes.source_text: Ni_xFe_{1-x}–AHNAs were prepared for the first time by a modified one-step chemical-deposition method under uniform electromagnetic field... electrodes with different Ni/Fe ratios were prepared by simply tuning the molar ratio of the Ni precursor over the Fe one

nodes.description: OER performance in 1 M KOH three-electrode cell
nodes.source_text: As illustrated in Fig. 3a, the Ni_{0.8}Fe_{0.2}–AHNAs show remarkably enhanced catalytic activity... the Ni_{0.8}Fe_{0.2}–AHNA shows the lowest overpotential of 190 mV to deliver 10 mA cm^{-2}... at the overpotential of 260 mV, the Ni_{0.8}Fe_{0.2}–AHNA catalyst exhibits a current density up to 1078 mA cm^{-2}... yield current densities of 500 and 1000 mA cm^{-2} stably over 120 hours at overpotentials of only 248 mV and 258 mV respectively

nodes.description: OER intrinsic activity normalized to ECSA in 1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: Ni0.8Fe0.2–AHNA shows the highest intrinsic catalytic activity, which affords 1 mA cm_{ECSA}^{-2} at an overpotential of 234 mV... significantly low overpotential of 255 mV to reach a current density of 10 mA cm_{ECSA}^{-2}

nodes.description: OER chronopotentiometric stability in 1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: we probed the long-term electrochemical stability of the Ni_{0.8}Fe_{0.2}–AHNA catalyst by testing at five constant current densities (10, 100, 500, 1000 and 10 mA cm_{geometric}^{-2}) for a total of 120 hours, and we found that the real-time potential presents negligible increase during continuous long-time operation
The bare Ni nanowire array shows the highest activity toward the HER, which affords 10 mA cm^{-2} and 1000 mA cm^{-2} at low overpotentials of 21 mV and 207 mV

nodes.description: Overall water splitting Ni0.8Fe0.2–AHNA(+)/Ni NW(-) electrolyzer in 1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: the Ni_{0.8}Fe_{0.2}–AHNA^{(+)}//Ni nanowire array^{(-)} water alkaline electrolyzer... requires only a cell voltage of 1.41 V to achieve a water-splitting current density of 10 mA cm_{geometric}^{-2}... generate extremely high current densities of 100, 500, and 1000 mA cm^{-2} at very low cell voltages of 1.55, 1.70, and 1.76 V... sustain an overall-water-splitting performance with negligible decay for over 24 hours when operating at constant current densities of 20, 100, and 500 mA cm^{-2}... nearly 100% faradaic efficiency

nodes.description: OER bubble release and wettability analysis at 10 mA/cm²
nodes.source_text: oxygen bubbles... leaving easily from the surface of Ni_{0.8}Fe_{0.2}–AHNA with a small size (i.e., smaller than 100 μm). The average sizes of the released bubbles from Ni_{0.8}Fe_{0.2}–AHNA... are calculated to be 76.2 μm... The bubble contact angle of Ni_{0.8}Fe_{0.2}–AHNA reaches 157.3°

nodes.characterization_summary: Large number of Ni_x Fe_{1-x} nanowires highly oriented and vertically rooted on nickel foam with distinctive gaps; nanowire diameter 70-130 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images show that a large number of Ni_x Fe_{1-x} nanowires are highly oriented and vertically rooted on the nickel foam with distinctive gaps between nanowires (Fig. 1b, c, and Fig. S1, ESI†).

properties.description: Scanning Electron Microscopy image showing bright particles on dark background

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows nanowires composed of nanoparticles with convex surface; diameter 70-130 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images show that Ni_x Fe_{1-x} nanowires with a convex surface are composed of nanoparticles (the inset of Fig. 1c and Fig. S2, ESI†).

nodes.characterization_summary: Nanowire consists of well-defined crystalline core and ultrathin 1-5 nm amorphous shell; lattice fringes spacing 0.202 nm correspond to (111) plane of Ni_x Fe_{1-x} alloy.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 1d and Fig. S6 (ESI†) show the high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM) images... the nanowire consists of well-defined crystalline phase in the core part, and an ultrathin layer (1-5 nm) of amorphous nano-domains on the surface.

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED pattern shows well-defined rings indexed to (111), (200), (220) and (311) planes of Ni_x Fe_{1-x} metal alloy.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The selected area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern was performed to confirm the crystal structure... all the well-defined rings can be indexed into the (111), (200), (220) and (311) planes of Ni_x Fe_{1-x} metal alloy.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDX mapping shows homogeneous distribution of Ni, Fe and O elements; Ni/Fe atomic ratio 4.3:1 matching ICP-AES result.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fe, Ni and O elements are homogeneously distributed over the nanowire even at very high magnification, according to the energy dispersive X-ray (EDX) spectrum (Fig. 1g).

nodes.characterization_summary: BET surface area measured as 7.4 m² g⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The specific surface area of the Ni_x Fe_{1-x}–AHNAs was also investigated with Brunauer–Emmett–Teller (BET) measurement, and the value was shown to be 7.4 m² g⁻¹ (Fig. S5, ESI†).

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD confirms fcc Ni_x Fe_{1-x} alloy core structure with (111), (200), (220) peaks; slight shift to lower angles and lattice expansion (3.52-3.55 Å) with increasing Fe content; no oxide/hydroxide peaks observed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The crystalline Ni_x Fe_{1-x} alloy core–amorphous shell structure was further confirmed by X-ray diffraction (XRD) (Fig. 2a). For the bare Ni nanowire arrays... three strong diffraction peaks located at 44.5°, 51.9°, and 76.4°... when the Fe content increases... the 2θ of (111) shifts from 44.28° to 44.07°.

nodes.characterization_summary: Surface shows Ni(OH)₂ (Ni 2p₃/₂ 855.5 eV, Ni 2p₁/₂ 873.5 eV), FeOOH (Fe 2p 710.6/723.8 eV), metallic Ni/Fe signals weaken with depth profiling revealing metallic core.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The fine-scanning Ni 2p spectrum from the nanowire surface... consisting of two spin–orbit doublets of Ni 2p₃/₂ (855.5 eV), Ni 2p₁/₂ (873.5 eV)... indexed as Ni(OH)₂... Fe 2p profile... peaks located at 710.6 eV and 723.8 eV... attributed to FeOOH.

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman shows broad peaks at 476, 558 cm⁻¹ (Ni-O in disordered Ni(OH)₂) and 311, 683 cm⁻¹ (disordered FeOOH) confirming amorphous surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Raman spectra further confirm the amorphous surface of the nanowires (Fig. 2f), where four evident broad peaks... can be assigned to the e_g bending and A_{1g} stretching vibrations of Ni–O in disordered Ni(OH)₂ clusters.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-AES determines Ni/Fe ratios for different compositions (Table S1).
nodes.evidence_snippet: electrodes with different Ni/Fe ratios were prepared... and were named as Ni₁Fe₀, Ni_{0.88}Fe_{0.12}, ... according to the inductively coupled plasma-atomic emission spectrometry (ICP-AES) analysis (Table S1, ESI†).

nodes.characterization_summary: ECSA values estimated using electrochemical capacitance measurement for intrinsic activity normalization.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The ECSA values were estimated using an electrochemical capacitance measurement method (Fig. S10, ESI†).
